title: Progress Software security advisory (AV26-1148)
description: As of November 12, 2026, Progress Software is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Telerik UI for ASP.NET Core
	Prior to 2026.3.1015

Telerik UI for WPF
	Prior to 2026.4.1110

Telerik UI for WinForms
	Prior to 2026.4.1111
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
